mechanism: Retain the causal v15 ADD signal and same-direction five-level depth filter, but admit at most one completed paper entry per vault and UTC day so no single leader can dominate the evidence.
temporal_operator: Process TRAIN signals in observable-time order. Apply a fixed signed-depth threshold of 0, 0.20, or 0.50, then enter after the canonical delay and exit after 30 or 60 minutes. Vault and coin daily counters use only earlier admitted entries.
conditioning: signed five-level depth imbalance minimum 0, 0.20, or 0.50
maximum one admitted entry per vault per UTC day
maximum one admitted entry per coin per UTC day
canonical full taker costs and observed five-level VWAP
direction-flip placebo on the same admitted identities
only complete causal entry and exit episodes enter aggregation
execution_translation: Paper-only Hyperliquid taker entry and exit at observed five-level VWAP with spread, slippage, adverse latency, and canonical fees reconciled. No order, network collection, carry PnL, future feature, or invented exit is allowed.
prediction_target: At least 4 USD net per TRAIN day with eight trades across three days, profit factor above one, direction placebo beaten, positive 418-trial-adjusted total lower bound, top positive trade share and largest vault and coin shares at most 60 percent, and complete counted episodes.
falsification_test: Reject if none of the six fixed depth-threshold and horizon variants passes every TRAIN gate. Heldout and forward outcomes remain unopened before freeze.
notes: TRAIN-only replay rejected without opening heldout. The best variant made 46.60 USD net over three days, beat placebo, reconciled costs and passed coin, vault, trade and liquidatability gates, but had six trades instead of eight and a negative 418-trial-adjusted lower bound.
rationale: V15 produced 71.51 USD net over four observed TRAIN days but one vault supplied 73.33 percent of trades. A one-entry-per-vault-day budget is causal and directly targets that sole deterministic gate failure while keeping the profitable execution mechanism unchanged.
